bear.notes: Mobile ad auction competition intensifies; Apple/Google privacy rules compress targeting; Apps segment drag persists; multiple compresses toward mature ad-tech

base.notes: AXON recommendation engine sustains share gains in performance marketing; Advertising segment 85%+ margins normalize slowly; buybacks offset dilution

bull.notes: Wurl CTV and non-gaming verticals scale; Apps portfolio sale removes distraction; AXON expands to retail/e-commerce advertisers globally

option_scan.question: GAAP book misstates core assets?
option_scan.evidence: Asset-light ad-tech platform; $2.5B cash at fair value on balance sheet (Financial-Update-Q4-2025.pdf)

option_scan.question: In-business loss segment?
option_scan.evidence: Apps Adjusted EBITDA $277M FY2024 (32% of revenue segment); strategic portfolio review ongoing (10-K FY2024 Item 1)

option_scan.question: Backlog / embedded product option in revenue path?
option_scan.evidence: Wurl CTV platform and AXON expansion into new verticals; growth modeled in base scenario, not separate terminal

option_scan.question: Portfolio divestiture / strategic review option?

option_scan.question: Material separate options after scan?

growth_explanation.mechanism: AXON AI engine improves advertiser return on spend, attracting more demand into AppDiscovery/MAX auctions; data flywheel from ~1.6B daily active users strengthens matching efficiency; Wurl adds connected-TV inventory
growth_explanation.source: 10-K FY2024 Item 1 Business; Q1 2026 financial update revenue +59% YoY at 85% Adjusted EBITDA margin

falsifiers.observation: IDFA/privacy changes reduce targeting efficacy for two consecutive quarters
falsifiers.action: Cut growth years 1-5 toward bear 6%; cap exit multiple at 20x

falsifiers.observation: Adjusted EBITDA margin falls below 75% while revenue growth decelerates below 20%
falsifiers.action: Downgrade moat to eroding; move stance toward trim

falsifiers.observation: Apps segment operating losses re-emerge without divestiture
falsifiers.action: Add explicit loss drag to owner cash normalization

human_review.notes: First filing-grounded dive; confirm whether to normalize FCF to Q1 2026 run-rate vs FY2025 filed; superinvestor letters cite APP as top contributor but are context-only pending approval.

paths.label: Bear scenario (Lawrence)
